readmeMarkdown:
# AGY Cockpit [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin-4285F4?logo=google&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/royjiang1982/agy-cockpit) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.1.0-0A7EA4)](./plugin.json) [![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.9%2B-3776AB?logo=python&logoColor=white)](https://www.python.org/) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-2EA44F)](./LICENSE) **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) **AGY Cockpit** is a real-time observability cockpit and multi-engine subagent orchestration plugin for **Google Antigravity**. Monitor context window usage, prompt cache hit rate, TPS/TTFT, token spend, and model quotas in the side pane — and centrally manage multi-engine subagent routing, resident execution, and safety guard hooks. ## Preview

Real-Time Cockpit Panel (demo data)
Subagent Orchestration Settings (demo data)
## Key Features - **Real-Time Metrics Dashboard**: Tracks context window utilization, prompt cache hit rate, decode speed (TPS), time-to-first-token (TTFT), per-turn trends, model cost breakdown, subagent consumption, and live quota rings. - **5-Role Subagent Orchestration**: Ships with the `cockpit-dispatch` skill and a zero-port local policy resolver (`resolve.py`) that routes tasks across 5 general-purpose roles with automatic fallback chains: - `scout` (read-only fast research) - `standard` (UI, visual & content tasks) - `deep` (backend logic, architecture & data pipelines) - `expert` (debugging, security/billing audit & acceptance) - `panel` (read-only multi-seat blind review) - **Self-Contained Resident Runtime**: Bundles `sa-subagentd` (Unix socket daemon) and engine wrappers (`sa-agy`, `sa-codex`, `sa-droid`, `sa-grok`, `sa-pi`) plus `sa-run.sh` for persistent connection reuse and multi-turn session resume. - **Native PreToolUse Safety Guard**: Automatically registers `hooks.json` (`sa-guard.sh agy`) to block recursive subagent spawning and high-risk shell/git commands inside subagent sessions. ## Repository Layout ```text agy-cockpit/ ├── plugin.json # Antigravity plugin manifest ├── hooks.json # Native PreToolUse safety guard hook ├── install.sh # One-way installer with syntax & hash verification ├── rules/AGENTS.md # Minimal always-on dispatch trigger rule ├── skills/cockpit-dispatch/ # 5-role dispatch skill + local policy resolver ├── runtime/ # Self-contained resident daemon, wrappers, runner & sa-guard └── sidecars/cockpit/ # Sidecar HTTP server, UI & unit tests ``` ## Quickstart ```bash # Install / sync into ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-cockpit ./install.sh # Run Sidecar and safety-guard unit tests PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s sidecars/cockpit -p "test_*.py" python3 runtime/tests/test-sa-guard.py ``` After installation, reload Antigravity and open the **AGY Cockpit** panel from the sidebar (or click the **Settings** button inside the Subagents section to toggle orchestration takeover and customize per-role routes).
latestReleaseNotes:
## Highlights

- **Smarter Subagent Dispatching**: Clearer always-on routing rules so the main agent reliably delegates research, UI/content, backend logic, expert review, and multi-seat panels instead of doing everything inline.
- **Read-Only Acceptance & True Blind Reviews**: Added `--read-only` for independent `expert` reviews and `--blind` for isolated `panel` reviews (excluding shared Swarm boards), plus safe fail-closed handling when policy files are corrupted.
- **Readable Subagent Task Names**: Fixed subagent rows showing generic `*-cli` labels — the Cockpit panel now displays concise core task names (≤10 chars) at a glance.
- **Safer Runtime & Safety Guards**: Removed private RPC dependencies, restricted AGY auto-approval to one-time permissions only, aligned default Droid quota fallbacks, and strengthened Swarm Worker, Git branch, daemon restart, and installer protections.
- **More Accurate Speed Metrics**: Prevented buffered-thinking turns from inflating decode TPS.

## 更新亮点（简体中文）

- **更准确的子代理自动分流**：补齐常驻触发边界与 5 角色必派清单，主代理会自动将侦察、视觉/图文、后端逻辑、专家验收与多方评审派给对应子代理，不再默认全揽自做。
- **只读独立验收与真盲审**：新增 `--read-only`（高危改动只读 `expert` 独立验收）与 `--blind`（`panel` 真盲审排除共享 Swarm 面板），策略文件损坏时自动止损停派。
- **子代理面板清晰任务名**：修复列表退化显示 `*-cli` 的问题，现自动提炼并展示 10 字以内的核心任务名称，一眼看清每个子代理在做什么。
- **运行时与安全守卫全面加固**：移除私有 RPC 依赖，AGY 自动审批仅放行单次授权（不再永久授权），统一默认 Droid 配额回退，并补强 Swarm Worker、Git 分支操作、守护进程重启校验与安装器边界防护。
- **解码速度统计更准确**：修复缓冲思考场景下首 Token 延迟导致解码 TPS 虚高的问题。

## Install / Upgrade

```bash
git clone https://github.com/royjiang1982/agy-cockpit.git
cd agy-cockpit && ./install.sh
```
